translation:
Patdi Bajanu

While going to Dwarka, at the halting place of Patdi Bajanu, a jambu (jamun) tree had dried up. It was said that by the time they went to Dwarka and returned it should turn green again — and it had turned green. Thus this place is now known as Jambudiyo Ovaro (the jamun-tree landing-ghat). Therefore this place of Patdi Bajanu, with its Jambudiyo Ovaro, is a punya sthali (a sacred, blessed place). The devotee Kanubhai Jivaji of Patravala has gone and visited this place.

Thus we shall call these places, which remind us of Sadguru Jivanji Maharaj, by the name punya sthali (sacred sites).
